title: Camera-fit math duplicated between command bus and view, fed by two different size sources
detail: Input and rendering each re-derive the screen-to-grid fit from different size sources (PlayerController viewport pixels vs widget local geometry). Sync is by comment only; drift desyncs where clicks land from where things draw.
recommended_fix: Own the fit in one place: the GameMode computes scale+offset+viewport size once and passes the same struct to ScreenToGrid and the view.

title: EndDraw's 'immediate refresh' BuildSnapshot cannot reach the view — rebuild only triggers on Tick change
detail: BuildSnapshot() rewrites Snapshot at the same Tick, so the view's tick-change gate never fires and the refreshed snapshot is not consumed this frame; the pipe renders at the next sim step. Adjacent comments claim both behaviors.
recommended_fix: On edit success, notify the view explicitly (RunView->RebuildWorld()) or add a snapshot serial the view compares; delete the dead same-tick BuildSnapshot call.

title: PIE fixture and demand hand-duplicated in StartRun instead of sharing the scenario builder (UAD-17)
detail: The scenario header exists so all surfaces share one builder ('cannot drift, UAD-17'); PIE becomes a fourth hand-rolled variant with different demand — and the comment says every 20 ticks while the loop steps 10.
recommended_fix: Factor a fixture-only helper (nodes + demand cadence, no pipe draws) into PP_Scenario.h; call it from StartRun and BuildProbeScenario.

title: FSnapshot omits Topology.Gen; the view detects topology change by counting nodes/pipes
detail: Count-compare misses equal-count topology changes once demolish lands (story 2.3; tombstones already scaffolded). Gen exists exactly for this trigger; the snapshot just doesn't carry it.
recommended_fix: Add uint32 TopologyGen to PPView::FSnapshot (set from SimState.Topology.Gen) and gate the static-world rebuild on it instead of array counts.

title: FPPCommandBus is stateless surface: DrawPipe ignores this, GetCommandBus() has no callers, APPRunGameMode forward decl unused
detail: DrawPipe reads no member state (its siblings SnapToNode/ScreenToGrid are already static); the accessor and forward declaration are speculative surface with no consumer.
recommended_fix: Make DrawPipe static like its siblings, delete GetCommandBus() and the unused APPRunGameMode forward declaration until a real consumer (MCP bridge) exists.

title: Probe golden JSON hardcodes save_magic/save_version instead of the spine constants
evidence:
PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:131:
				 ",\"save_magic\":\"PPUE\",\"save_version\":2,\"catalog_hash\":\"%016llx\""
— vs PP_SimState.h:35:
	inline constexpr uint32_t SAVE_VERSION = 2;
and compare-golden.sh:29 pins it as a compared key:
  "seed" "ticks" "tick_nonce" "state_hash" "save_magic" "save_version"
detail: If SAVE_VERSION bumps, the probe JSON silently reports the stale literal instead of the spine's format version, while compare-golden.sh treats save_version as compared truth.
recommended_fix: Print PP::SAVE_VERSION in the Printf (and derive the magic string from SAVE_MAGIC) instead of hardcoded literals.
